answer: A grove can be replanted anywhere, so a claim rooted in one must be traced before credit moves. Each identity needs two holders outside its own cluster to countersign its voyage, and one countersignature backs one identity, so n aliases need n distinct witnesses rather than one cooperative ring. Every passage is priced by rank: the k-th filing costs k squared in bond, so a farm pays near n cubed while still requiring unrelated guarantors. A tide audit replays a random passage each epoch, and an unconfirmed one forfeits its bond to the pool.
